name: better-auth-native-hooks
reason: These provider-specific Effect callbacks preserve Better Auth's hook parameters and results, including the caller's native provider options.

name: better-auth-native-test-context
reason: Provider integration tests supply a real Better Auth instance, its test plugin context and its native migration options.

name: native-typescript-rule-analysis
reason: Quality rule helpers consume native TypeScript nodes, symbols and checkers so custom analysis composes with the compiler without a second AST model.

name: native-vitest-dom-environment
reason: The DOM environment preset is a native Vitest configuration that consumers compose with their runner configuration.

name: native-react-components-and-contexts
reason: React components, providers and contexts retain native ReactNode and Context types so applications use the renderer directly.

name: native-vitest-rerun-state
reason: The Vitest plugin merges runner attempts and snapshots through native Vitest test modules, state and snapshot environments.

name: native-board-react-rendering
reason: The browser entry renders React components and shares native React contexts and refs with its document and table components.

name: native-board-router
reason: Board navigation composes a native TanStack router, route tree and history location used by the React application.

name: native-board-status-icons
reason: Status presentation returns Lucide React icon components for the React renderer; replacing their native props would hide the icon contract.

name: native-board-markdown-directives
reason: Markdown template and visual transforms consume native mdast directive nodes so they compose with the Markdown parser tree.

name: native-vitest-app-config
reason: The Vitest application configuration builder preserves the native Vite configuration accepted by Vitest, including Vite plugin types.

name: native-board-route-tree
reason: The native TanStack React router returns its route tree through router-core types, preserving typed navigation for the browser entry.

name: native-browser-story-rendering
reason: Browser stories mount application React trees, so the public render callback accepts native ReactNode values.
